item.guhs.flitskruimel.lore: A crumb that still flickers from an Ender Mika. Blink and it lies a little further off. Nyeg.
item.guhs.doosschil.lore: A round piece of cheese box, pushed out by a Hidey Guh for a nibble. Two around a chest: a Hidey Box.
block.guhs.schuildoos.tooltip: Keeps everything that is inside, even when you pick it up. Doesn't fit in another Hidey Box (a guh tried).
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.gejat: Hey! An Ender Mika swipes a nibble from your hand. Stare right at it and it will drop it. NYEG!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.laat_vallen: The startled Ender Mika drops your nibble. Quick, pick it up!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.terug: The Ender Mika didn't dare eat it after all: your nibble is back in your pocket.
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.mijt_uit_vrucht: Pop! A Cheese Mite jumps out of your fruit. Watch your toes...
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.gekieteld: Tickle tickle! The Cheese Mite tickles your toes. Hic!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.kusje: Smooch! A smooch from the Hidey Guh. It makes you float a little...
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.schil: Crack! The Hidey Guh pushes out a box shell. Thank you, guh!
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.schil_morgen: This Hidey Guh already gave a box shell today. A new one will have grown by tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_mikas.schuilguh_dicht: Shut! The Hidey Guh is in its little box for a moment. Wait until it peeks again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ender_mika: Rarity: Rare, on the outer islands of the Guh End
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ender_mika: A Mika that stood staring into the void for so long that it got all stretched out: tall, thin and purple-black, with glowing little eyes. It flits from island to island and adores cheese nibbles: hold one in your hand and it sneaks around behind you and swipes exactly one. It is terribly shy: stare right at it for two seconds and it drops your nibble in fright. Whack it and it shoves you over and flits away. If a Cheese Mite is around, it forgets everything and trudges after it, head over heels. NYEG.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kaasmijt: Rarity: Sometimes out of a nibble chorus fruit
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmijt: A teeny-tiny critter made of cheese crumbs, with six little legs and two glowing feelers. Now and then one jumps out of a nibble chorus fruit you just took a bite of. It scurries up to you and tickles your toes, and that gives you the hiccups. Hic! After a couple of minutes it is gone again. Ender Mikas think Cheese Mites are the prettiest thing there is and trail after them dreamily: so with a little mite around, your nibbles are safe.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schuilguh: Rarity: On the walls of a Mika Fortress
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schuilguh: A sweet, shy guh that lives in a little round cheese box, stuck to a wall, the ceiling or simply the floor. Come closer calmly and it peeks out from under its little lid. With an empty hand you get a smooch: it makes you float for a moment (you land softly, it is still a guh). Give it a cheese nibble and it pushes out a box shell, once a day. If it gets a fright, its lid snaps shut. Shut!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_mikas_ender_m: On the &5outer islands&r of the Guh End, tall, thin, purple-black Mikas stand staring into the void. Look at them and they shyly &dflit&r away. Get close (just for a moment) for your Guhdex. And mind your &6cheese nibbles&r: hold one in your hand and it swipes one. Stare right at it for two seconds and you get it back!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_mikas_flitskr: An Ender Mika is a real Mika: whack it and it shoves back. Sometimes it leaves a &dFlash Crumb&r behind, a crumb that still flickers a little. Keep it safe, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_mikas_kaasmij: Eat a &5nibble chorus fruit&r and sometimes... pop! Out jumps a &echeese mite&r, a teeny-tiny crumb critter that tickles your toes. That gives you the &ehiccups&r. Ender Mikas trail after it dreamily and forget all about your nibbles.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_mikas_schuilg: Little round cheese boxes hang on the walls of a &5Mika Fortress&r. Come closer calmly and a &dHidey Guh&r peeks out from under the little lid. An empty hand: you get a &dsmooch&r and float for a moment. Don't worry, you land softly.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_mikas_doossch: Give a Hidey Guh a &6cheese nibble&r: it pushes out a &ebox shell&r. It does that once a day, so find more than one (or come back tomorrow).
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_mikas_schuild: A box shell, a &6chest&r and another box shell, one under the other: a &dHidey Box&r. It keeps everything that is inside, even when you pick it up. A whole chest full in one slot. WAHOOG!
